description: The plot illustrates how the number of “Shared Experts for Two Samples” varies with “Sample Token Count” across six task categories (Intent, Summary, Law, Translation, Code, Math). The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and uses a logarithmic base-2 scale with tick labels from \(2^9\) through \(2^{20}\) at every power of two. The y-axis is labeled “Shared Experts for Two Samples,” appears linear, and spans roughly from 2.0 up to 6.0 with labeled ticks at 0.5 increments (2.0, 2.5, …, 6.0). The Intent series is a solid reddish-brown line that rises from about 3.8 at \(2^9\) to about 6.0 by \(2^{19}\)–\(2^{20}\), with a visible dip near \(2^{11}\) (around 3.9) before increasing to about 5.5 at \(2^{13}\) and then gradually approaching 6.0. The Summary series is a solid blue line starting near 1.9 at \(2^9\), increasing sharply to about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), dipping slightly around \(2^{12}\) (about 4.5), then climbing to roughly 5.4 at \(2^{14}\) and reaching about 5.9–6.0 by \(2^{18}\)–\(2^{20}\). The Law series is a solid yellow/gold line beginning around 3.6 at \(2^9\), rising to about 5.1 at \(2^{11}\), dipping near \(2^{12}\) (about 4.6), then increasing to around 5.6–5.8 between \(2^{13}\) and \(2^{14}\), and approaching about 5.9–6.0 by \(2^{18}\)–\(2^{20}\). The Translation series is a solid purple line that starts around 5.1 at \(2^9\), drops to about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), then increases to about 5.6 at \(2^{12}\) and continues upward to roughly 5.9–6.0 by \(2^{18}\)–\(2^{20}\). The Code series is a solid gray line that begins near 1.9 at \(2^9\), rises gradually to about 3.1 at \(2^{12}\), reaches about 3.7 at \(2^{13}\), dips near \(2^{14}\) (about 3.1), then increases steadily to about 5.3–5.4 at \(2^{17}\)–\(2^{18}\) and ends around 5.7–5.8 at \(2^{20}\). The Math series is a solid green line starting around 3.8 at \(2^9\), increasing to about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), then rising more gradually to about 5.3 at \(2^{13}\)–\(2^{14}\) and reaching approximately 5.9–6.0 by \(2^{18}\)–\(2^{20}\).
